stories.title: FMI eleva projeção para economia global, mas vê ganho concentrado com a IA

en.title: IMF raises global economy projection, but sees gains concentrated in AI
en.summary: The International Monetary Fund slightly increased its forecast for global economic growth in 2026 to 3.1%, up from 3.0% projected in July. The organization expects United States growth to remain stable at 2.3% in 2026 and 2027.

stories.title: Irmã de homem morto pela PM após 24 tiros em SP diz que ele tinha esquizofrenia: 'Não sabem lidar com uma pessoa?'

en.title: Sister of man killed by police after 24 shots in SP says he had schizophrenia: 'Don't they know how to handle such a person?'
en.summary: The sister of Antonio Nunes Batista, who died after police gunfire during a stop in São Paulo, questions the officers' response and states her brother had schizophrenia and could have been restrained using alternative methods.

stories.title: FMI reduz projeção de crescimento do Brasil, mas eleva a da economia global

en.title: IMF reduces Brazil growth projection, but raises global economy forecast
en.summary: The International Monetary Fund lowered its GDP growth projections for Brazil and China while raising its forecast for global economic growth, according to a report released on Monday.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera votos do pai em todas as rendas, e Lula cresce entre mais ricos

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surpasses father's votes across all income levels, and Lula grows among the richest
en.summary: Lula lost votes across most income distribution compared to the 2022 first round, except among the top 4% richest where he gained support, while Flávio Bolsonaro outperforms his father across all income brackets.

stories.title: 'Violência extremada e desproporcional', diz advogada da família de jovem morto pela PM com 27 tiros

en.title: 'Extreme and disproportionate violence', says lawyer for family of young man killed by police with 27 shots
en.summary: A lawyer for the family of Gustavo Munis Santana, 20, who was killed by military police in São Paulo on Saturday, characterized the police action as inadmissible.

stories.title: Site da Ancine sofre ataque hacker com mensagens contra Lula e ataques a nordestinos

en.title: Ancine website suffers hacker attack with messages against Lula and attacks on northeastern people
en.summary: The website of Brazil's film agency Ancine was targeted in a cyberattack featuring messages critical of President Lula and disparaging content directed at residents of Brazil's northeast region.

stories.title: Flávio e Lula acenam a católicos com Nossa Senhora após polêmica no primeiro turno

en.title: Flávio and Lula gesture to Catholics with Our Lady after controversy in first round
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and President Lula participated in tributes to Nossa Senhora Aparecida on Monday, a holiday celebrating Brazil's patroness saint, following electoral campaign controversy from the first round.

stories.title: Nunes Marques insiste em censura pró-Flávio

en.title: Nunes Marques persists in censorship favoring Flávio
en.summary: Supreme Electoral Court president Kassio Nunes Marques pursued additional censorship measures, which the outlet suggests further damaged the credibility of the judiciary.

stories.title: Nunes Marques marca reunião com campanhas de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula para tratar de 2º turno

en.title: Nunes Marques schedules meeting with campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula to discuss second round
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court president convened a meeting between the campaigns of presidential candidates Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro to address conduct issues during the second round runoff. The court had issued conflicting decisions regarding a Lula support group on a messaging platform.

stories.title: TSE manda Flávio e aliados removerem vídeo falso sobre uso de cocaína por menina em ato pró-Lula

en.title: Electoral court orders Flávio and allies to remove fake video about cocaine use by girl at pro-Lula rally
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court mandated the removal within 24 hours of posts by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign and supporters that used decontextualized images to falsely associate attendees of a pro-Lula demonstration with drug consumption.

stories.title: Site da Ancine é invadido e exibe xingamentos a Lula e foto de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Ancine website hacked and displays insults against Lula and photo of Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Brazil's National Cinema Agency portal was compromised by hackers, briefly displaying a screen with insults directed at President Lula and Northeastern people, featuring a composite image with Flávio Bolsonaro and other political figures.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula aciona TSE após post falso sobre comício na Paulista

en.title: Lula's campaign files complaint with electoral court over false post about Paulista Avenue rally
en.summary: Lula's reelection coalition filed a complaint with the electoral court seeking removal of false posts linking old images of drug users to attendees of a Paulista Avenue rally and falsely attributing vandalism episodes to the PT party.

stories.title: Quando é o próximo feriado? Ano ainda terá mais três finais de semana prolongados

en.title: When is the next holiday? The year will still have three more long weekends
en.summary: Following the October 12 holiday, the next national holiday in Brazil will be All Saints' Day on November 2, which falls on a Monday and may create an extended weekend for workers not required to work.

stories.title: FMI aponta ‘resiliência notável’ da economia global, mas alerta para riscos associados a dívidas e inflação

en.title: IMF points to 'remarkable resilience' of global economy, but warns of risks associated with debt and inflation
en.summary: The IMF maintains its 3.1% global growth forecast despite energy market turbulence, but cautions that uncontrolled financing costs and inflation could trigger significant economic slowdown.

stories.title: Programa eleitoral de Flávio Bolsonaro homenageia Nossa Senhora Aparecida, mas vai ao ar sem áudio

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign program pays tribute to Our Lady of Aparecida, but airs without audio
en.summary: A campaign broadcast for Flávio Bolsonaro featuring a tribute to Brazil's patron saint and appearances by writer Augusto Cury aired without audio, prompting criticism of the Superior Electoral Court over a technical failure attributed to media companies.

stories.title: Boom da IA está concentrando crescimento global em menos países, diz FMI

en.title: AI boom is concentrating global growth in fewer countries, says IMF
en.summary: The IMF warns that while maintaining steady global growth projections, artificial intelligence investment concentration and energy shocks are widening economic divergence between nations.

stories.title: Comitê Paralímpico leva desenho animado sobre inclusão de pessoas com deficiência ao Instagram

en.title: Paralympic Committee brings animated series about inclusion of people with disabilities to Instagram
en.summary: The Brazilian Paralympic Committee launched an Instagram profile for the animated series "Unstoppable Paramigos," which follows characters on adventures across Brazil focusing on inclusion and environmental protection, timed with Children's Day.
